source.scope: inventory every metadata capture for each visit; HEAD all available highres/intrinsics/trajectory assets before download; train/cal first then eval if byte/time budget fits
source.coordinates: merge cross capture only with official shared-world or transform evidence; otherwise retain separate components and render target-capture component only, report incomplete whole-visit registration
source.missing_pose: no extrapolation; retain UNKNOWN; source frame outside trajectory omitted with receipt

surface.provenance: number of unique source frame IDs per voxel
surface.render: 256x192 pinhole front-facing circular camera-plane surfel splat, optical-Z nearest-depth zbuffer; no hole filling

synthesis.model: v1 frozen expected photon return plus Skellam and ambient

readout: exact v1 seal bytes; SNR>=3, coverage>=.75, support>=16pixel; frozen pooled304 RGB reused

coverage_gate.zone_pass: v1 coverage>=.75 AND noisy peak SNR>=3; main rho.3 ambient1 K0 primary; report K1 and all arms too
coverage_gate.missing_frames: retained as failure; no threshold relaxation

geometry_checks.original_51: input geometry consistency comparison only, no model outcomes; keep train/cal and eval input checks separate
geometry_checks.near_coverage: subrays optical-Z .3-.8m hit counts and unknown counts; unknown distance cannot be assigned near band without reference
geometry_checks.residual_fit: train+cal original18 effective frames only; eval33 NEVER fit noise distribution
geometry_checks.residual_reason: 51 total includes sealed eval; fitting on it would violate visit train/cal/eval isolation
geometry_checks.residual_distribution: signed registered FARO minus native optical-Z at finite paired pixels, empirical by fixed bands [.3,.8),[.8,1.5),[1.5,3]; independent deterministic per-pixel resampling, no tuning, nonpositive invalid; outside bands UNKNOWN

evaluation.train_cal: 6 arms x K2 x fixed ToF/RGB/OR/AND by27queries; original v1 native reference and RGB predictions reused
evaluation.common_subset: all arm input source and grid/RGB pose valid; determined before model outcome; also disclose per-zone missingness
evaluation.eval: inputs only integrity frames/coverage/hash; no method query metrics or alarm rates
evaluation.M3_S: frozen continuous16frames on merged FARO, valid complete windows only; HEAD/BODY descriptive, no contact accuracy

decision_check: v1 only51/384 registered FARO; target308/384 frames each52/64 passing zones; coverage pass does not prove real ToF or justify threshold tuning; failure retains v1.1 partial source. Static 2.5D reconstruction shares official filtered-source bias.
